video: RoomC.mp4 (55 s, retaken to cover the whole room)

runs.label: Run 1
runs.note: First full pipeline on the retaken video. Before the fixes below, this run sat at 55% for 4 rounds with 12 of 12 fixes rejected.
changes: Dividing walls (partitions) for rooms that aren't a plain rectangle
Loop repairs inherited problems (colour names, decor with physics, toggles with no switch) so fixes are judged on what they change
Interaction tests fixed: cabinets swing a front door, only lamps need a light, only floor obstacles count
Model calls time out and retry instead of hanging

runs.label: Run 2
changes: Arched and half-round windows; one wall can be brick while the rest are plaster
Lockers are a grid of small doors (4×4 here); cabinets are hollow with front doors
Dividing walls described as thin walls, not blocks
Describe reports whether a doorway has a door panel, so no phantom door
Openable furniture keeps its doors; tests only count obstacles at the same height

runs.label: Run 3
runs.note: Same system, every model call made fresh (no cache): shows how much a run varies. Argon read the alcove as a thick block this time.
changes: Fresh run: DOORWAY_FRESH=1, nothing reused from earlier runs
